columns.name: aun
columns.description: State agency ID (9 digits) for the school district, charter school, or career center.

columns.name: lea_name
columns.description: Agency name as in the state's files.

columns.name: county
columns.description: County.

columns.name: lea_type
columns.description: school_district, charter_school, career_technology_center, or other.

columns.name: sy
columns.description: Spring year of the fiscal year (2024 = FY 2023-24, July to June).

columns.name: total_expenditures
columns.description: All expenditures reported, including facilities and other financing uses (debt service and refunding), in nominal dollars.

columns.name: instruction_1000
columns.description: Instruction (function 1000).

columns.name: support_services_2000
columns.description: Support services (function 2000).

columns.name: noninstructional_services_3000
columns.description: Operation of noninstructional services (function 3000).

columns.name: facilities_construction_4000
columns.description: Facilities acquisition, construction, and improvement (function 4000).

columns.name: other_expenditures_financing_5000
columns.description: Other expenditures and financing uses (function 5000), including debt service and refunding.

columns.name: local_revenue_6000
columns.description: Total local revenue (6000).

columns.name: current_real_estate_taxes_6111
columns.description: Current real estate taxes (6111).

columns.name: state_revenue_7000
columns.description: Total state revenue (7000).

columns.name: basic_education_funding_7110
columns.description: State Basic Education Funding (7110).

columns.name: federal_revenue_8000
columns.description: Total federal revenue (8000).

columns.name: other_revenue_9000
columns.description: Other revenue (9000): bond and note proceeds, transfers, and similar. Not operating revenue.

columns.name: salaries_obj_100
columns.description: Salaries (object 100).

columns.name: benefits_obj_200
columns.description: Employee benefits (object 200).

columns.name: charter_tuition_paid
columns.description: Tuition a school district paid to charter schools (brick-and-mortar and cyber, regular and special education). Blank for charter schools and career centers.

columns.name: tuition_paid_total
columns.description: All tuition a school district paid, to any recipient.

columns.name: actual_instruction_expense
columns.description: The state's actual instruction expense for the school district (2008-09 to 2023-24).

columns.name: general_fund_balance
columns.description: Committed + assigned + unassigned general fund balance.

columns.name: current_expenditures_approx
columns.description: Instruction + support services + noninstructional services (1000 + 2000 + 3000). Approximates the commission's 'current expenditures', which also nets out tuition-for-patrons revenue, so this runs slightly high. Derived.

columns.name: adj_adm
columns.description: Adjusted average daily membership: the enrollment base the state uses in the Basic Education Funding formula (school districts only), from the state's BEF workbooks.

columns.name: current_exp_per_weighted_student
columns.description: The state's current expenditures per weighted student in the BEF formula. Its weighted-student count is not the same as the commission's or Kelly's, so do not compare it with their adequacy targets per student.

columns.name: current_expenditures_net_of_patron_tuition
columns.description: The state's current expenditures minus tuition from patrons revenue (the definition in the funding law and the commission's adequacy calculation), from the BEF workbooks. School districts only; 2016-17 to 2022-23.

columns.name: rtl_total_allocation
columns.description: The state's Ready to Learn Block Grant allocation for the school district (payable year = this fiscal year), as allocated, not as booked. School districts only.

columns.name: rtl_adequacy_supplement_allocation
columns.description: The adequacy supplement within the Ready to Learn Block Grant (enacted from 2024-25): the state's adequacy investment for this district that year. It is new money added in that year and rolls into the next year's foundation, so do not add years without noting that.

columns.name: rtl_tax_equity_supplement_allocation
columns.description: The tax equity supplement within the Ready to Learn Block Grant (enacted from 2024-25).

columns.name: current_expenditures_per_adj_adm
columns.description: current_expenditures_approx divided by adj_adm. Derived; dollars per adjusted ADM, nominal.

columns.name: pde_enrollment
columns.description: October 1 enrollment of the agency's own schools, from PDE's public school enrollment file (2016 on). For a school district it excludes students it pays to attend charter schools; a charter school's row is its own enrollment.

columns.name: pde_low_income_students
columns.description: Low-income students counted on October 1 (PDE).

columns.name: pde_low_income_share
columns.description: pde_low_income_students divided by pde_enrollment.

columns.name: current_expenditures_per_pde_enrollment
columns.description: current_expenditures_approx divided by pde_enrollment. Derived. Left empty for school districts, whose spending includes tuition paid for students they do not enroll; for charter schools and career and technical centers it is spending per enrolled student.

columns.name: essa_adm
columns.description: Average daily membership in the state's ESSA per-pupil expenditure report (2018-19 on), the sum over the agency's school buildings.

columns.name: essa_expenditures_total
columns.description: Personnel and non-personnel expenditures from local, state and federal funds charged to the agency's school buildings in the ESSA report (2018-19 on). Not the same as total expenditures: it leaves out most central, debt and transfer costs.

columns.name: essa_expenditure_per_adm
columns.description: essa_expenditures_total divided by essa_adm. Derived.
